title: Generative Semantic Segmentation via an Observable Semantic-Image Interface and Hierarchical Generator Evidence Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2608.11537v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative semantic segmentation exposes structured predictions as images, but direct color decoding is susceptible to color drift and boundary mixing, whereas latent-feature decoders that predict a separate output distribution may relegate the rendered image to an intermediate visualization. We present Semantic Prism, a conditional semantic-image generation-and-refinement framework with deterministic inference. A diffusion-distilled one-step generator renders a semantic RGB image; per-pixel distances from the rendered colors to a fixed class-color codebook define an explicit probabilistic interface. Hierarchical Generator Evidence Alignment spatially aligns multi-level generator features and uses a zero-initialized output projection to predict an additive residual in the interface logit space, retaining the image-defined interface as the reference for the final distribution. The interface and refined distributions further enable Conte

translated_title: 基于可观测语义图像接口与层级生成器证据对齐的生成式语义分割
translated_abstract: 生成式语义分割将结构化预测呈现为图像，但直接的颜色解码容易受到颜色漂移和边界混合的影响，而预测独立输出分布的潜在特征解码器可能将渲染图像降级为中间可视化。我们提出了Semantic Prism，一个具有确定性推理的条件语义图像生成与细化框架。一个基于扩散蒸馏的单步生成器渲染语义RGB图像；渲染颜色到固定类颜色码本的逐像素距离定义了一个显式的概率接口。层级生成器证据对齐在空间上对齐多层级生成器特征，并使用零初始化输出投影在接口对数空间中预测加性残差，保留图像定义的接口作为最终分布的参考。该接口和细化分布进一步支持Conte（后续内容）。
tldr: 提出了一种通过可观测语义图像接口和层级生成器证据对齐的生成式语义分割方法，有效解决了颜色漂移和边界混合问题。
en_tdlr: A generative semantic segmentation method using an observable semantic-image interface and hierarchical generator evidence alignment, effectively addressing color drift and boundary mixing issues.
